title: Netherlands & Belgium 2026 Outdoor Construction Material Open Dataset & Engine (Concrete, Gravel, Sand, Tiles, Big Bags & 750 kg Trailer)
description: Open 2026 reference datasets (JSON/CSV) and zero-dependency ESM calculation formulas published by KlusBerekenen (klusberekenen.com) aligned with Dutch NEN-EN 206, CROW, and RDW guidelines for the Netherlands and Belgium. Covers concrete 25 kg bag yields and 1:2:3 self-mix (https://klusberekenen.com/beton-berekenen/), 750 kg unbraked trailer payload trip counts (https://klusberekenen.com/beton/25kg-zakken-per-m3/), gravel/split/sand bulk densities with compaction, garden tiles, and Big Bag sizing.
